简介:
Lutz was born in Milan, the daughter of Elliston Lutz (b. July 1, 1959) and Maria Licci (b. January 26). She has an older brother, Martin Perry Lutz (b. January 18), and a younger half-brother, Alexey Lutz (b. August 6, 2001).
1、When she moved to Los Angeles she worked as waitress in a restaurant called "Terroni" (pejorative Italian term which refers to people from Southern Italy).
Hobbies include reading, traveling and singing.
2、Her favorite movies include Sophie's Choice (1982), Léon (1994), Roman Holiday (1953), Mommy (2014).
3、Studied Psychology at Milan's Catholic University until she decided to move to Los Angeles to take acting lessons. Her teachers include Larry Moss and Michael Rogers.
4、Practices boxing, surfing and rock climbing.
5、Her acting models include Valeria Golino, Meryl Streep, Monica Vitti, Marilyn Monroe and Michelle Williams.
